evidence.tierBehavior: The route loads real rounds before loading the owner tier and applying the Free last-20 cap.
queryCharacteristics: Dashboard Round Focus performs its own round candidate, stored insight, and viewer entitlement reads where applicable.
The main dashboard round query includes course location plus tee holes for every matching real round.
Hole-by-hole rows are loaded for the selected statistics round IDs.
One list/search query loads the requested course page.
Each returned course then triggers a separate findUnique including location, all tees, and all holes.
Static route-level shape is one list query plus N full-course queries; this is not a runtime query-count measurement.
One user search query returns candidates.
Each candidate performs a friendship query and conditionally outgoing and incoming request queries.
Static worst-case route-level shape is one plus three times N queries; this is not a runtime query-count measurement.
